rules.usdaEnergy: nutrient 208 (Energy, kcal); if absent 958 (Atwater specific), then 957 (Atwater general)
rules.usdaRounding: nearest: kcal to 0 decimals, grams to 1 decimal; low == high
rules.usdaPortions: per 100 g, plus up to two USDA household portions in USDA order (RACC, labels over 60 characters and portions over 1000 g skipped)
rules.compositeRounding: outward: lows rounded down, highs rounded up (kcal 0 decimals, grams 1 decimal)
rules.wideningRule: sum ingredients (per-100 g × grams / 100); low end with the least oil, high end with the most; then low × (1 − w), high × (1 + w) with the recipe's w
rules.fibre: null (unknown) when the source does not report it — never 0; a composite is unknown if any ingredient is
rules.carriedConfidence: carried-over core estimates keep their numbers unchanged; a core confidence of high is seeded as medium (a FITOS estimate is never high)
rules.ifct: IFCT 2017 per 100 g; kcal = kJ / 4.184 (IFCT's 0 kJ for its oils and ghee is computed with IFCT's own factors 17/37/17/8 kJ per g); each value +- the SD IFCT reports, kept within 3-10 %, rounded outward; left out: a missing value, and energy more than 25 % from 4/4/9 of its macros; verified, high confidence; used by the owner's decision of 2026-10-25 without NIN's written permission (ADR-036)
rules.indb: INDB 2024 per piece / bowl as INDB serves it (its per 100 g is of the raw ingredients, so unused); +-10 %; a deep-fried recipe has the pan taken out and keeps the fat CoFID measured in fried food of its kind, +-15 % (beta 3.9; samosa, vada, cutlet and other kinds CoFID cannot check within +-15 % are left out); left out: whole dishes, portions outside 5-900 kcal, energy more than 25 % from 4/4/9 of its macros, and a recipe FITOS already has (by name or alias); never verified (ADR-036)
rules.cofid: UK CoFID 2021 (gov.uk, Open Government Licence v3.0) measured as eaten: plain foods +-3 %, dishes +-8 %; a replaced FITOS composite keeps its slug, name, aliases and serving (ADR-036); the fried dishes listed as oil references only calibrate the fried INDB recipes and are never foods (beta 3.9)
rules.names: a measured food never repeats a name: an IFCT name FITOS already uses gets "(IFCT)", an INDB recipe FITOS already has is skipped; an alias that is another food's name is dropped
